ruleDefinitions.name: Add Port Monitor Persistence in Registry
ruleDefinitions.description:
Adversaries may use port monitors to run an attacker supplied DLL during system boot for persistence or privilege escalation.
A port monitor can be set through the AddMonitor API call to set a DLL to be loaded at startup.
 Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Control\\\\Print\\\\Monitors\\\\.*") AND Details = RGX("\\\.dll$")) AND  NOT ((process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\spoolsv\.exe" AND registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Control\\\\Print\\\\Monitors\\\\CutePDF\\ Writer\\ Monitor\\ v4\\\.0\\\\Driver.*") AND Details = "cpwmon64\_v40\.dll" AND (user = RGX(".*AUTHORI.*") OR user = RGX(".*AUTORI.*"))) OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Control\\\\Print\\\\Monitors\\\\MONVNC\\\\Driver.*") OR (registry_path = RGX(".*Control\\\\Print\\\\Environments\\\\.*") AND registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Drivers\\\\.*") AND registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\VNC\\ Printer.*")))
